author: Veli Raiya
title: Looking for fantasy book map designer + character illustrator
content:
Looking for a fantasy book map designer + character illustrator! 👀 Definitely doesn’t have to be the same artist for both.

Bonus points if you’re a fantasy author recommending someone you’ve personally worked with because I know the bots are about to find me 😂

See the next posts for more details on what I’m looking for with each! 🤍

For character art, I tend to gravitate toward more realistic, epic fantasy concept art, as opposed to a cartoon illustration.

My book is on the lighter side of fantasy, but I love art that still feels grounded and lifelike.

I’m definitely open to seeing different styles though, so please share your work/recs!

Bonus points if you can do POC and a wide variety of ethnicities!

For the map, I’d love something detailed and immersive with that classic fantasy-map feel, but I’m pretty open stylistically!

It’s a very visual world, I’m so excited to describe it to someone 🎨

Thanks in advance!!

Contact: DM on Threads or share portfolio in replies.
